findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/managed-host-run-e2e-smoke.ts:275-303 does not provide stable current coverage: after a fresh build, its pinned command failed twice at line 289 with timed_out instead of running. The test gives the crashed worker a real 500ms deadline at line 275, while core/managed-host-run.ts:1411-1421 independently arms that real deadline timer; injecting now=deadlineAt-1 into status cannot stop it expiring first. This also makes managed-host-run-smoke and managed-cross-provider-suite-smoke fail, so the recorded passing evidence cannot currently establish CHK-001:edge:1, CHK-002:adversarial:2, CHK-007:happy:0, CHK-007:edge:0, or CHK-007:adversarial:0. Make the crash/deadline probe deterministic without allowing the real worker timer to preempt its status-seam assertions, then rerun and record the affected pinned evidence.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: Fresh aggregate and direct pinned smoke failures required focused inspection of the worker-deadline and status-reconciliation seams.
